name: ClawEval
intro: Claw-Eval 是面向真实自主 Agent 的可审计端到端评测套件，包含 300 个经人工验证的任务和 2,159 条细粒度 Rubric，通过执行轨迹、服务审计日志和环境快照评估完成度、安全性、鲁棒性与多次运行可靠性。
org: Peking University, The University of Hong Kong
build_method: 250个原创任务+50个兼容任务, 运行环境与Rubric实现, 独立复核, 前沿模型试跑
metric: Average Score, Pass@3, Pass³, Completion, Safety, Robustness
modality: 文本, 图像, 视频, 代码
task_type: 工作流Agent任务, 多模态任务, 多轮专业对话
eval_feature: 全轨迹审计, 三证据通道, 时间防火墙, 受控错误注入, 三次独立运行
task_type_en: Workflow agent tasks, multimodal tasks, multi-turn professional dialogue
build_method_en: 250 original plus 50 compatibility tasks, runtime and rubric implementation, independent review, and frontier-model pilot validation
eval_feature_en: Full-trajectory auditing, three evidence channels, temporal firewall, controlled error injection, three independent trials
intro_en: Claw-Eval is an auditable end-to-end suite for real-world autonomous agents. Its 300 human-verified tasks and 2,159 fine-grained rubrics use execution traces, service audit logs, and environment snapshots to evaluate completion, safety, robustness, and multi-run reliability.
metric_en: Average Score, Pass@3, Pass³, Completion, Safety, Robustness

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2604.06132v3, §§3.1–3.3 and Appendices B–E, the official GitHub snapshot d3f02d4938ab0832377d90535013def2b1a2fdc0, and Hugging Face dataset snapshot ca978fd82edb77d52f26f4ccf3f9684a8df84341. The paper releases 250 original and 50 compatibility tasks (OfficeQA 10, PinchBench 14, FinanceQA 12, OneMillion-Bench 5, Video-MME 5, LongVideoBench 4), after environment/rubric implementation, second-author review, and multi-frontier-model pilots. The final 300 tasks contain 2,159 rubric items across nine categories. Setup, Execution, and Judge are temporally separated; execution traces, service audit logs, and environment snapshots ground grading. Score = Safety × (0.8 Completion + 0.2 Robustness); three trials and threshold 0.75 produce Average Score, Pass@3, and Pass³.
